# Code Anchors: AWS Deployment

- `infra/src/app.ts` — the AWS CDK app with the two stacks; skips the backend stack for a web-only deploy
- `infra/src/backend-stack.ts` — backend stack: retained table, function, function URL, role, log group
- `infra/src/web-stack.ts` — hosting stack: private bucket and CloudFront distribution
- `infra/src/names.ts` — fixed resource and stack names
- `infra/src/cdk.ts` — runs AWS CDK bootstrap and stack deploys with rollback on
- `infra/src/aws.ts` — the real AWS calls the commands make; never imported by stacks or tests
- `infra/src/setup.ts` — setup: bootstrap, both stacks, health check, both addresses
- `infra/src/update-backend.ts` — backend update: backend stack only, then health check
- `infra/src/update-web.ts` — web view update: hosting stack, build, upload, invalidation
- `infra/src/upload.ts` — changed-file upload, page last, removed files after
- `infra/src/web-build.ts` — web view build from the deployment's three values
- `infra/src/commands/setup.ts` — `pnpm aws:setup` entry point
- `infra/src/commands/update-backend.ts` — `pnpm aws:update-backend` entry point
- `infra/src/commands/update-web.ts` — `pnpm aws:update-web` entry point
- `infra/project.json` — never-cached Nx targets that depend on the builds
- `package.json` — the four `aws:*` root scripts
- `scripts/emulator.sh` — repeatable backend zip build
- `backend/project.json` — backend build inputs and outputs
- `docs/setup/deploy-aws.md` — deployment guide: first-run order, bootstrap, permissions
